d67c8f23c462.name: AlphaSpace
d67c8f23c462.text: Marvell will acquire Lumentum in a deal valued at $115 billion. The transaction would be the largest merger between two publicly traded companies on record. Lumentum shareholders will get 4.5 shares of Marvell stock for every Lumentum share they own.
d67c8f23c462.note: Deal size and 4.5 exchange ratio — the core terms bankers will model first.

d67c8f23c462.name: REX Shares
d67c8f23c462.text: MARVELL BETS BIG ON LIGHT WITH $115 BILLION LUMENTUM DEAL. $MRVL agreed to acquire $LITE in an all stock deal with an enterprise value of $115 billion, making it one of the largest tech transactions ever.
d67c8f23c462.note: Frames the deal as an optics bet to challenge Broadcom in AI connectivity.

d67c8f23c462.name: 456X
d67c8f23c462.text: Lumentum ($LITE) guided Q2 revenue to $1.575-1.625B, representing 140% growth at the midpoint, even as Marvell ($MRVL) agreed to acquire the company for 4.5 Marvell common shares per Lumentum share. In Q1, Lumentum posted revenue of $1.26B and an operating margin of 42.3%.
d67c8f23c462.note: Why LITE holders care: monster guide vs stock-as-currency takeover risk.

d67c8f23c462.name: Anadolu English
d67c8f23c462.text: US chipmaker Marvell Technology has agreed to acquire optical components maker Lumentum in an all-stock deal valuing the company at $115B. The merger will combine Lumentum’s lasers and optical components with Marvell’s AI chips and networking technology.
d67c8f23c462.note: Clean strategic rationale: lasers + AI networking in one stack.

35d489695b45.name: zz哥（虾湖说）
35d489695b45.text: The AI arms race is accelerating. The money is starting to look stretched. Even OpenAI is lowering its price to secure funding. According to the Financial Times, Bloomberg and CNBC, OpenAI has cut its latest pre-IPO fundraising target from $30 billion to about $20 billion.

35d489695b45.name: Trevor Noren
35d489695b45.text: The staggering circularity of the AI buildout and its dependence on two frontier labs that still lack a clear path to profitability: Anthropic has committed to pay as much as $895.4 billion for AI computing power and infrastructure through 2045, according to its IPO filing.
